what_this_is: The presentation film, described by the sources that build it. Every field below is derived from presentation/src at generation time rather than read from a document, so nothing written by hand can disagree with it about the same film.

beats.name: Title
beats.narration: TraceTriage. Which satellite passes are worth a reviewer's time.

beats.name: Problem
beats.narration: Volunteers point radios at satellites, then judge what came back by eye. This frozen snapshot holds two thousand seven hundred and twenty seven captures. Only 739 carry a decisive verdict. The rest were recorded, and nobody read them.

beats.name: Queue
beats.narration: So the queue ranks 407 observations by what a reviewer would learn, and spends a fixed budget of 50 on the top of it. Not the loudest signals. The ones where the evidence disagrees with itself: 17 stale catalogue frequencies, and 3 where the model and the network label do not match.

beats.name: Physics
beats.narration: The shape is the test. From this pass's own orbital elements, propagated with S G P 4, the expected Doppler curve spans seventeen thousand two hundred and ninety hertz. Slide that curve 113 pixels and it lands on the trace. The gap is the measurement: plus thirteen thousand nine hundred and eighty five hertz, plus 32.05 parts per million. This station had already taken the Doppler out, and nothing in the observation record says so.

beats.name: Result
beats.narration: The gate written down in advance asked the queue to find one and a half times as many conflicts as random ordering at the same budget. It found 20 where random expects 12.6. That is a lift of 1.58. The interval runs 1.35 to 1.74, so it straddles the bar, and this is published as not established.

beats.name: Gates
beats.narration: Six gates, with their thresholds, written down before anything was measured. 3 of 6 were met. A point estimate above the bar whose interval crosses it counts as a failure here, which is stricter than the brief asked for.

beats.name: Established
beats.narration: Three results did come back decided. Read-only evidence tools take a local Granite model from 2 of 24 right to 22 of 24. The grounding checker caught 525 of 525 planted falsehoods, and refused 0 of 175 clean drafts. On ground stations the queue was never fitted to, lift is 2.25, and that one passes.

beats.name: Colophon
beats.narration: The waterfall in this film is a public SatNOGS capture, cited and licensed.

claims.reading: A claim is a value resolved from a key path in one of the files below at build time. The ones read and never drawn are cross-checks the test suite uses, not figures on screen.

what_this_does_not_measure: Whether the film is any good, or whether a viewer follows it.
Whether the rendered file plays. The digests say only that the committed bytes are the bytes this receipt was written about.

Whether the numbers are right. They are the receipts' own numbers, and each receipt's own study is what establishes them. This receipt establishes only that the film reads them rather than restating them.
